rule.ranking: rank each momentum descending cross-sectionally (best=1), arithmetic mean of the two ordinal ranks, choose lowest-average-rank Top2; equal-weight holdings
rule.final_liquidation: official 2026-07-01 open; extended latest snapshot session open; forced by audited account engine
